cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Appreciation Skills
cards.back: Dance appreciation is the ability to analyse, describe and evaluate dance works using informed judgement

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Appreciation Skills
cards.back: The AO4 framework is the AQA assessment objective for appreciation: analyse and evaluate dance

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Appreciation Skills
cards.back: Analysis means breaking down a dance into its component parts to understand how it works

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Appreciation Skills
cards.back: Description involves identifying and clearly stating what you see in a dance performance

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Appreciation Skills
cards.back: Evaluation requires making informed judgements about the effectiveness and quality of a dance work

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Appreciation Skills
cards.back: The three skills work together: you describe what you see, analyse how it works, then evaluate how effective it is

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Appreciation Skills
cards.back: AO4 is worth 40% of the GCSE Dance written exam, making appreciation skills essential

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Appreciation Skills
cards.back: Effective appreciation uses subject-specific terminology accurately and consistently

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Appreciation Skills
cards.back: Analysis should consider choreographic intent, movement content, structure and design elements

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Appreciation Skills
cards.back: Evaluation must be supported with evidence from the dance — opinions need justification

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Appreciation Skills
cards.back: Appreciation skills are applied to both professional works and your own choreography

cards.front: Recall a key point about Dance Appreciation Skills
cards.back: AQA expects you to link your analysis to the choreographer's intention and audience impact

cards.front: What should you know about gcse dance exam tips — dance appreciation skills?
cards.back: 1. For Dance Appreciation Skills questions, identify the relevant area of law and state the legal principles clearly 2. Apply legal rules to the facts of the scenario — don't just state the law 3. When evaluating, consider both the effectiveness and fairness of legal rules 4. Reference relevant cases and statutes when discussing Dance Appreciation Skills 5. Consider reform proposals and alternative approaches where relevant
Explain the three skills of dance appreciation (describe, analyse, evaluate) and how they work together when responding to a dance work. [6 marks]

AO1 (Performance): Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of dance appreciation skills, including choreographic processes, performing skills and dance appreciation relevant to AQA 8236. AO2 (Choreography): Apply knowledge and understanding of dance appreciation skills through the creative process of choreography, selecting and using movement material and choreographic devices.
